texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Applied	is	exposed	to	risks	as	a	result	of	ongoing	changes	in	the	various	industries	in	which	it	operates.
texts.text: Applied	is	exposed	to	risks	as	a	result	of	ongoing	changes	in	the	various	industries	in	which	it	operates.

texts.label: text

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Applied	is	exposed	to	risks	as	a	result	of	ongoing	changes	specific	to	the	semiconductor	industry.
texts.text: Applied	is	exposed	to	risks	as	a	result	of	ongoing	changes	specific	to	the	semiconductor	industry.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The	 largest	 proportion	 of	 Applied's	 consolidated	 net	 sales	 and	 profitability	 is	 derived	 from	 sales	 of	 manufacturing	 equipment	 in	 the Semiconductor	Systems	segment	to	the	global	semiconductor	industry.	In	addition,	a	majority	of	the	revenues	of	Applied	Global	Services	is	from	sales to	semiconductor	manufacturers.	The	semiconductor	industry	is	characterized	by	ongoing	changes	particular	to	this	industry	that	impact	demand	for and	the	profitability	of	Applied's	semiconductor	manufacturing	equipment	and	service	products,	including:
texts.text: The	 largest	 proportion	 of	 Applied's	 consolidated	 net	 sales	 and	 profitability	 is	 derived	 from	 sales	 of	 manufacturing	 equipment	 in	 the Semiconductor	Systems	segment	to	the	global	semiconductor	industry.	In	addition,	a	majority	of	the	revenues	of	Applied	Global	Services	is	from	sales to	semiconductor	manufacturers.	The	semiconductor	industry	is	characterized	by	ongoing	changes	particular	to	this	industry	that	impact	demand	for and	the	profitability	of	Applied's	semiconductor	manufacturing	equipment	and	service	products,	including:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · the	increasing	frequency	and	complexity	of	technology	transitions	and	inflections,	and	Applied's	ability	to	timely	and	effectively	anticipate and	adapt	to	these	changes;
texts.text: the	increasing	frequency	and	complexity	of	technology	transitions	and	inflections,	and	Applied's	ability	to	timely	and	effectively	anticipate and	adapt	to	these	changes;

texts.label: list_item

texts.text: the	increasing	cost	of	research	and	development	due	to	many	factors,	including	shrinking	geometries,	the	use	of	new	materials,	new	and more	complex	device	structures,	more	applications	and	process	steps,	increasing	chip	design	costs,	and	the	increasing	cost	and	complexity	of integrated	manufacturing	processes;
